description: Compares the net cost of buying a home (down payment, mortgage payments, tax, insurance, and maintenance, minus principal repaid and appreciation gain) with the total rent paid over the years you plan to stay, and gives a verdict plus the equity built. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive rent vs buy calculator calculator.

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment percent of the home price.

home_insurance_annual.description: Homeowner insurance per year in USD.

maintenance_pct.description: Maintenance per year as a percent of the home value.

property_tax_annual.description: Property tax per year in USD.

stay_years.description: Years planning to stay in the home.

name: calculate_rent_vs_buy
